notes.title: Duskborn Patch 0.2.1
notes.notes:
New Features


  New effect Ground Bombardment can now drop from AJAX Dragonfly
 AJAX cutting prism effect will now automatically switch targets when the current target is dead
 Boss enemies can now drop loot orbs, that can be collected by the player to obtain their attacks
 Squidling seekers now predict the direction of their target, making them more difficult to dodge
 the duration of buff effects now also scales with the effectiveness of the trigger they are associated with.


Balancing


 nerfed OnCriticalStrike trigger
 health of stationary enemies (Angels, Annihilators and Bosses) now scales stronger with current depth, making them tankier when looping.
 tuned down strength of player dash
 Hydraulic Overload now also buffs jetpack refuel rate
 removed Winch Enhancer buff
 Exoskeleton Overdrive now also buffs grappling speed
 utility buffs now last longer
